sentences.text: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar For the Petitioners : Mr. Sidhartha Roy, Adv.

For the Opposite Party : Mr. V. K. Gupta, A.P.P. ....
03/07.06.2018 Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned APP.

The applicants have prayed for regular bail in connection with Penk Narayanpur P.S. Case No. 41 of 2017 corresponding to G.R. No. 798 of 2017 registered under Section 429/406/188/120-B IPC,
Sections 11(a), (d),
(e), (i), (k) of Animal Cruelty Prohibition Act, 1960, Section 3 of Animal Slaughter Act, 2001 and Section 55 of Food and Safety Standard Act.
It is alleged that 10 unclaimed camels were seized and was entrusted to different persons.

Later on,
after Bakrid the camels were not produced and also those persons did not appear before the authority.
It is alleged that those persons may have sacrificed the camels during Bakrid.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that co-accused namely Shahid Ansari @
Md. Shahid Ansari has been granted bail vide B.A. No. 8517 of 2017 by the Hon'ble coordinate Bench of this Court.
Learned APP has opposed the prayer for bail.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants, above named, are directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-
(Rupees ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M., Bermo at Tenughat in connection with Penk Narayanpur P.S. Case No. 41 of 2017 corresponding to G.R. No. 798 of 2017.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Tanuj/
